module: Network Security Platform Sensor NS7150, NS7250 and NS7350
caveat: When operated with the tamper evident seals installed as indicated in the Security Policy. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: Network Security Platform products (formerly known as IntruShield) are Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) that protect network infrastructures and endpoints from intrusions such as zero-day, DoS, spyware, VoIP, botnet, malware, phishing, and encrypted attacks with highly accurate, enterprise-class risk-aware intrusion prevention. The Network Security Management system manages the sensor deployments and permits the customer to receive real-time network status updates and alerts, implement customized security policies and incident response plans, and perform forensic analysis of attacks.
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (key agreement; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength); NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength)
hardware_versions: P/Ns IPS-NS7150 Version 0.60, IPS-NS7250 Version 0.60 and IPS-NS7350 Version 0.60; FIPS Kit P/N IAC-FIPS-KT2

approved.cavp_cert: AES Cert. #4801 and HMAC Cert. #3208, key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength
